ledger: handheld object | initially a white razor-like object in right hand | ends as a white razor-like object in right hand | transforms into a black comb at 00:02, transforms back into a white razor at 00:04

findings.description: The white razor-like object in the man's hand spontaneously transforms into a black comb as he raises his hand to his hair. There is no action of putting down one object and picking up another.
The black comb in the man's hand spontaneously transforms back into a white razor-like object as he brings his hand back down to his face.
